title: Storm Queen Over Maelstrom
description: A powerful female warrior with long white hair and glowing blue armor stands on a crumbling icy cliff, holding a large glowing hammer aloft as lightning strikes around her. Below, a massive swirling maelstrom pulls sailing ships and figures into its vortex amid a chaotic stormy sea with crashing waves and flying debris.
prompt: A dramatic fantasy scene of a powerful female warrior with flowing white hair and glowing blue armor standing on a breaking ice cliff, raising a large glowing hammer to the sky. A massive swirling maelstrom vortex pulls old sailing ships and figures into the turbulent ocean below. Dark stormy clouds with lightning, crashing waves, and flying debris fill the chaotic seascape.
